question: After the existing canonical BTC fast trend enters a positive episode, does exposed BTC/ETH/SOL history contain recurrent, duration-aware transitions in which ETH or SOL becomes the unique durable relative leader, with a repeatable causal anatomy beyond the coarse existing V1 absolute/relative-trend eligibility rule?
hypothesis: BTC-positive phases contain recurrent Beta leadership handoffs, but the handoff is not a fixed N-day lag. Instead, state age plus fast-versus-slow ETH/BTC and SOL/BTC relative trend, relative acceleration, two-asset Beta breadth and participation should characterize a leader-to-follower-to-new-leader transition whose realized durable opportunity can be identified consistently across distinct BTC-positive episodes.
economic_mechanism: The existing V1 already requires positive BTC trend plus positive alt absolute and relative trend, but prior BRRK evidence shows that once a single alt winner exists the portfolio may retain economically costly BTC weight. 0047 therefore does not retest whether positive relative trend exists; it studies whether leadership transfer has recurrent timing, duration, acceleration, breadth and participation anatomy. The study is diagnostic only. It does not fit a handoff model, choose a switch threshold, change BRRK weights, or test portfolio economics.
stopping_rule: After this preregistration is merged, implement exactly one frozen 0047 anatomy protocol on a separate pre-result branch and execute it exactly once after that implementation boundary is green. Any hard stage-gate failure or insufficiency closes 0047 under the frozen classification. No universe, BTC-positive episode rule, 20/60 realized target horizon, causal trend horizon/weight, acceleration definition, breadth definition, trade-participation definition, state-age definition, cross-correlation lag range, VAR lag order, Granger panel, IRF horizon, bootstrap unit/seed, oracle rule or hard gate may change after any 0047 output is observed. No hazard model, HMM, classifier, BOCPD rescue, fixed-delay rescue, portfolio allocation or portfolio economics may be evaluated under this ID.
success_criteria: At least 5 distinct target-eligible canonical BTC-positive episodes exist.
At least 3 distinct target-eligible BTC-positive episodes contain a mechanically defined primary durable handoff.
Episode-level durable handoff prevalence is at least 0.50.
ETH is the primary durable handoff cause in at least 1 distinct episode.
SOL is the primary durable handoff cause in at least 1 distinct episode.
All episode boundaries, target availability, censoring, cause assignments and primary-event dates are produced mechanically from the frozen definitions with zero manual relabeling.
All complete-episode dependence and 10,000-replicate bootstrap semantics use the frozen seed 470047 where uncertainty is reported; no daily IID confidence claim is used as a promotion gate.
No causal feature, horizon, target, episode, universe, transmission diagnostic, oracle or stage-gate definition changes after any 0047 output is observed.
Canonical BRRK-0011, the winner lineage, exhaustion lineage, Phase 6, execution configuration, production authorization, signing and order-submission authority remain unchanged.
failure_criteria: Fewer than 5 distinct target-eligible BTC-positive episodes produces INSUFFICIENT_EPISODE_DIVERSITY and closes 0047.
With sufficient episode diversity, fewer than 3 primary durable-handoff episodes or episode-level prevalence below 0.50 produces FAIL_NO_RECURRENT_DURABLE_HANDOFF_STRUCTURE and closes 0047.

If recurrence gates pass but only one of ETH or SOL is ever observed as the primary handoff cause, classify INSUFFICIENT_COMPETING_RISK_DIVERSITY for the intended later three-outcome architecture and close 0047 without same-ID scope expansion.

Any manual episode/event relabeling, observation after 2026-08-02, post-output definition change, alternate 20/60 target horizon, added BNB/alt universe, lag-order search, BOCPD/HMM/classifier rescue, fixed-delay search, portfolio allocation or portfolio economics invalidates the run rather than becoming a second 0047 result.
allowed_followup: Only PASS_DURATION_AWARE_HANDOFF_MODEL_STAGE_ELIGIBLE may create a new separately preregistered duration-aware handoff-model research ID using the frozen 0047 information families and whole-episode validation.
A later model stage may preregister a discrete-time competing-risk duration-aware architecture with outcomes NO_HANDOFF, ETH_HANDOFF and SOL_HANDOFF, but 0047 itself may not fit it.
Only after a later handoff model independently passes its own gates may a separate portfolio-translation ID preregister winner concentration candidates and portfolio economics.
forbidden_followup: No same-ID 40/60, 20/80, 0/100 or any other BTC/winner allocation test.
No same-ID CAGR, Sharpe, Sortino, Calmar, maximum-drawdown, turnover or transaction-cost optimization.
No same-ID hazard model, semi-Markov model fit, HMM, classifier, tree, boosting model, neural network or handoff-probability threshold.
No same-ID fixed N-day post-BTC switch delay selected from results and no alternate target horizon selected after output review.
No same-ID BOCPD rescue and no expansion from BTC/ETH/SOL to BNB or other alts after results.
No use of the hindsight one-switch oracle to choose labels, causal features, model form, switch timing or later allocation.
No canonical BRRK modification, Phase 6 modification, leverage, shorting, signing, order submission or production authorization.
researcher_decisions: The exact scientific source is research/governance/BRRK_BETA_HANDOFF_EVENT_STUDY_0047_DESIGN_FREEZE_2026-08-11.md merged by PR #169 at 398b7ec3f78f602461787b1b45e8d5041729e126; this preregistration copies that design and does not reopen method selection.

Primary assets are exactly BTC, ETH and SOL. BNB is excluded from the 0047 competing-risk target even though earlier BRRK winner research included BNB; expanding the cause universe after results is forbidden.

Market data are Binance spot BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT and SOLUSDT UTC daily klines with open/high/low/close/volume/quote_volume/trades from 2020-08-01 through 2026-08-02 inclusive on one common contiguous daily index.
Canonical trend mathematics are reused exactly from frozen V1: horizons 20/60/120/240, FAST weights 0.15/0.25/0.30/0.30 and SLOW weights 0.10/0.20/0.30/0.40 over tanh-scaled log momentum components.

A BTC-positive episode is every maximal contiguous run with canonical BTC_TREND_FAST >=0. Negative or NaN ends the episode. There is no persistence filter, bridging, minimum-return condition or manual bull-market anchor.
STATE_AGE is the 1-based common-session count since the start of the current BTC-positive episode.
For ETH and SOL, causal features include ABS_FAST, ABS_SLOW, REL_FAST and REL_SLOW versus BTC; REL_ACCEL is exactly REL_FAST minus REL_SLOW and is not independently tuned.
BETA_BREADTH is exactly the mean of two participation indicators, where an asset participates only when its ABS_FAST>0 and REL_FAST>0. The only possible breadth values are 0.0, 0.5 and 1.0.

Participation confirmation is exactly log(1+daily trade count) minus its trailing 60-session median with minimum 60 observations. Quote volume is preserved in raw evidence but is not a second primary participation candidate.
Existing V1 ETH/SOL score and eligibility may be reconstructed only as a benchmark because positive absolute and relative trend are already frozen repository mechanics, not a new 0047 discovery.

The realized durable target is hindsight-separated from causal predictors. For h in {20,60}, F_h_x(t)=log(P_x[t+h]/P_x[t]). A Beta cause requires BTC forward return>0 at both horizons and the same Beta asset to strictly beat BTC and the other Beta asset at both horizons.
If t+60 is unavailable at the frozen dataset end, the target is right-censored/target-unavailable rather than negative.

The primary handoff event per BTC-positive episode is the earliest target-available durable handoff date. Later ETH-to-SOL or SOL-to-ETH switches are secondary descriptive observations only and do not create additional primary events.
The handoff opportunity spell is consecutive target-available sessions after the primary event during which the same primary cause continues to satisfy all frozen durable-target conditions.

Cross-correlation uses daily log returns and lags exactly -14 through +14, with each pair required to remain inside the same BTC-positive episode; episode boundaries are never concatenated as adjacent observations.

The transmission model is exactly one pooled common-coefficient VAR(7) over [BTC,ETH,SOL] daily log returns with episode fixed intercepts; a row is eligible only if t and all seven lags lie in the same BTC-positive episode. There is no lag-order search.

Granger/Wald diagnostics report all six directed pairs. They are descriptive and cannot create or rescue the primary stage classification. Where possible uncertainty is episode-cluster-aware; naive daily IID significance is not a promotion gate.

Generalized rather than Cholesky-ordered impulse responses are reported for a one-residual-standard-deviation BTC return shock at horizons 0 through 14, avoiding an arbitrary contemporaneous ordering assumption.

Dependence-aware uncertainty resamples complete BTC-positive episodes exactly 10,000 times with seed 470047. Daily rows and overlapping 20/60 forward targets are not treated as independent observations.

The one-switch oracle starts already 100% BTC at each episode start and permits no switch or exactly one BTC-to-ETH/SOL switch held through episode end. A full switch incurs L1 turnover 2.0 at 5 bps per absolute weight change, or 10 bps total switch cost. It is HINDSIGHT_OPPORTUNITY_BOUND / NOT_TRADABLE / NOT_OOS and is never a hard PASS gate.
BOCPD is excluded as a primary or rescue candidate under 0047 because a concrete implementation adds hazard/prior freedoms. Any later BOCPD study requires its own pre-result freeze.

0047 intentionally does not fit the planned duration-aware competing-risk model. If 0047 passes, that model belongs to a new research ID with whole-episode holdout/leave-one-episode-out evaluation and no random daily-row split.

0047 intentionally does not test winner concentration or portfolio economics. 60/80/100 percent winner concentration, net CAGR, cash credit and transaction-cost economics belong to a still later separately preregistered portfolio stage.

All 0047 history is researcher-exposed DEVELOPMENT. Even a full 0047 PASS proves only recurrence/modeling sufficiency on exposed history and creates no OOS, canonical, dynamic-gross or production authority.
production_relevance: Research-only, result-informed and externally hypothesis-informed Stage-1 mechanism/anatomy test on researcher-exposed BTC/ETH/SOL history. A full PASS can only make a separately preregistered duration-aware handoff-model stage eligible; it cannot change BRRK targets, authorize portfolio concentration, modify Phase 6 or confer production authority.
notes: Design boundary merged before formal preregistration at 398b7ec3f78f602461787b1b45e8d5041729e126.
Winner 0001/0002 are motivation that BTC retention may be costly after a single alt winner exists; they do not identify handoff timing and are not independent evidence for 0047.

External literature motivates information diffusion, fast/slow momentum, price transmission and duration dependence, but no paper is treated as evidence that the exact BTC-to-ETH/SOL handoff exists in this dataset.

The current V1 already has positive absolute/relative alt trend eligibility. 0047 therefore studies incremental timing, duration, acceleration, breadth and participation anatomy rather than relabeling the existing rule as new alpha.
VAR/Granger/IRF and the hindsight oracle are mandatory diagnostics but explicitly non-gating. A strong oracle or significant Granger test cannot rescue absent recurrent durable handoffs.
No portfolio allocation, CAGR optimization or dynamic gross is permitted under 0047.
